embed_video: embed a watermark into a video file using a Videoseal model and save the watermarked output
embed_video_clip: embed a watermark into a video clip array using a Videoseal model and return the processed clip
detect_video: detect and extract watermark bits from a watermarked video file using a Videoseal model
detect_video_clip: detect and extract watermark bits from a video clip array using a Videoseal model
run_inference_streaming: run the Video Seal CLI to embed and detect watermarks in a video file end-to-end
